text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - spike in 5xx rate for /v1/generate (us-east). Alert INC-20240511-01. Grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/alerts/INC-20240511-01 :rotating_light:
Priya (oncall): Ack. Joining warroom. Warroom -> https://meet.redwood/warroom/INC-20240511-01  I'll take initial comms and triage owner unless someone else prefers it.
Alex (SRE): I'll own investigation for now. First glance shows surge in errors tied to model-serving pool queue depth. Pulling logs and checking autoscale.
Maya (eng-runtime): Noted. Model pool queue depth + KV cache miss rate spike. Suggest temporary fallback to staging model variant (degraded quality but healthy) to keep customers online while we mitigate.
Ben (prodops): I can enact the fallback routing once we decide. Proposed plan: shift 100% traffic to staging-variant for us-east, monitor errors for 10m, then iterate.
Priya (oncall): +1 for fallback. Ben, go ahead when ready. I'll draft status page update now: "Investigating increased error rates in US-East. Traffic is being routed to a healthy fallback while we resolve the issue."
Ben (prodops): Starting gradual route flip (10% -> 100% over 60s). Command: ```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/route \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"service":"api-router","region":"us-east","target":"staging-variant","duration_s":60}'
```
Ben (prodops): Flip in progress -> 30%... logs show 200s stabilizing.
Priya (oncall): Status page draft posted to #incidents-drafts for review. Customer-support tagged for outbound comms: @support-team please prepare external note if we maintain >5% errors after fallback.
support-bot: Notified support channels and queued canned message template: https://wiki.redwood/cs/templates/incident-outage. Customers on dedicated contracts listed; recommend priority email if SLA impacted.
Maya (eng-runtime): Investigating root: KV cache throttle on cache-shard-7. Starting rolling restart on shard nodes to clear transient backpressure.
Alex (SRE): I've increased edge request queue limit temporarily and bumped autoscaler min replicas for us-east model pool. Monitoring effect on 5xx rate.
Ben (prodops): Flip completed -> 100%. Observed immediate drop in 5xx to ~1.2%. Continuing to monitor for 10m before declaring mitigation.
Priya (oncall): Good signal. Assigning action items: Maya -> continue KV shard investigation and post RCA notes; Ben -> own routing/status page updates; Alex -> follow autoscale changes and metrics; Priya -> external comms and exec summary.
Priya (oncall): Pager handoff: I'll hand to Tom at 04:15 UTC for the next shift. Tom please ack when you're in.
Tom (oncall-east): Ack. I'm here and will pick up monitoring & warroom cadence at handoff.
Priya (oncall): Thanks team — initial kickoff closed. We'll keep this thread for live updates. Next update in 10 minutes or sooner if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
